sentences.text: Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in criminal case having FIR No.121 dated 3.6.2022 registered under Sections 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC at Police Station Dharamkot, District Moga.

Present case is relating to execution of one sale deed alleged to be executed by the present petitioner impersonating herself as Prito daughter of Sunder Singh who was the original owner of the land in question.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner, who is aged about 75 years, has joined the investigation with the police in compliance of previous order of interim bail.

State counsel on instructions from ASI Jasbir Singh has not refuted the aforesaid assertions made by the counsel for the petitioner and further submits that the petitioner is not required by the police for further investigation or custodial interrogation.
